title: Projection comparison for perfect complexes
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is perfect, meaning of finite Tor dimension: for every x\in X the local ring \mathcal O_{X,x} has finite Tor dimension as an \mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}-module (for a morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes this is the Stacks notion of a perfect morphism, under which \mathcal O_X is locally perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] relative to Y), let c be a right adjoint to the derived direct image Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image] on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and let K be a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] on Y. Let Lf^* be the derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] and \otimes^L the derived tensor product of \mathcal O_X-modules, computed by K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The canonical comparison morphism Lf^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y)\to c(K) is the morphism corresponding under Rf_*\dashv c to the composite Rf_*(Lf^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y))\cong K\mathbin{\otimes^L}Rf_*c(\mathcal O_Y)\to K\mathbin{\otimes^L}\mathcal O_Y=K of the projection-formula isomorphism and the counit Rf_*c(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathcal O_Y. Then this comparison morphism is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Because f is proper between Noetherian schemes, it is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so the projection-formula isomorphism [lem-pc-projection-formula] applies to E=c(O_Y) and every quasi-coherent complex on Y. Composing this isomorphism with the counit Rf_*c(O_Y) \to O_Y gives exactly the morphism whose mate under Rf_* dashv c is the comparison morphism in the statement.

proof.text: Let K^vee be the dual of K given by [lem-pc-perfect-tensor-hom-duality]; by the pullback clause of that statement (with g=f), Lf^*K is perfect on X with dual Lf^*K^vee. For every E in D_QCoh(O_X), apply the second tensor-Hom isomorphism of [lem-pc-perfect-tensor-hom-duality] on X to the pair (Lf^*K, Lf^*K^vee) with A=E and B=c(O_Y), then the adjunction Rf_* dashv c, then the projection-formula isomorphism [lem-pc-projection-formula] (with E and K^vee), and finally the second tensor-Hom isomorphism on Y for the pair (K,K^vee) with A=Rf_*E and B=O_Y, to obtain the natural chain Hom_X(E, Lf^*K tensor^L c(O_Y)) = Hom_X(Lf^*K^vee tensor^L E, c(O_Y)) = Hom_Y(Rf_*(Lf^*K^vee tensor^L E), O_Y) = Hom_Y(K^vee tensor^L Rf_*E, O_Y) = Hom_Y(Rf_*E, K) = Hom_X(E, c(K)). Naturality of every identification shows that the map induced by the comparison morphism is the identity: its mate is, by definition, the projection-formula map followed by the counit, which is exactly the middle pair of maps in this chain. Hence Yoneda implies that the comparison morphism is an isomorphism.
